text:
By Corey Fuller ,
9 hours ago NYC is always packed with incredible new things to do , but this breathtaking exhibit is truly on another level. After an extensive three year planning process , the legendary Musée d’Orsay in France has officially transformed a massive space at Chelsea Piers. ARTE MUSEUM: An Immersive Media Art Exhibition 4.68 (9630 reviews) 28 May 2026 10:00 + more dates Arte Museum New York From $35.00 The highly anticipated collaboration with Arte Museum takes the classic gallery format and completely flips it on its head . While the venue has been a massive hit with New Yorkers since opening earlier this year, this mind-blowing immersive journey into Parisian masterpieces is exactly why everyone is calling it the absolute future of art. And here’s how to visit it while it’s still happening. The ultimate NYC and Paris connection The Musée d’Orsay is globally celebrated for holding the absolute largest collection of Impressionist and post-Impressionist masterpieces in the world. Housed in a stunning former railway station in Paris , it is a massive bucket list destination for art lovers everywhere.
